members.interpretation: NAB CR6 residential mortgage agreements map to arrangement count.
members.rationale: The existing agreed principle distinguishes counted arrangements from monetary exposures and explicitly accepts this scoped NAB mapping. It does not establish distinctness or another bank's counting unit.
members.decision_context: Transcription of an already agreed researcher interpretation recorded in the data-semantics principle, not a new interview. Original decision date was not recorded; created_on is this catalogue revision date.
